actions.action: Confirm and freeze the exact selection
actions.mechanism: Separate visible-page selection from all matching records; confirmation binds an immutable ID set, not a live filter.
actions.implementation: Provide keyboard-accessible choices labeled “25 on this page” and “600 matching records.” Resolve IDs before confirmation; persist the confirmed count and scope.
actions.check: Change filters and add matching records after confirmation; verify every submitted ID belongs to the frozen set. Test with a screen reader.
actions.risk: Resolving all IDs may require a loading state.

actions.action: Skip records changed since scope confirmation
actions.mechanism: Atomic version checks distinguish concurrent edits from the user's confirmed targets without silently overwriting newer work.
actions.implementation: Capture versions alongside selected IDs. Add conditional writes to the bulk handler; return a conflict outcome when a version differs.
actions.check: Modify one selected record immediately before its write; verify it remains untouched and receives a readable conflict explanation.
actions.risk: Conflicts require refreshed information and explicit reconfirmation before retry.

actions.action: Recover failures through a persistent outcome ledger
actions.mechanism: Per-record outcomes drive retries; operation tokens deduplicate requests when responses are lost.
actions.implementation: Persist confirmed IDs and outcomes under an operation token. Offer keyboard-accessible “Retry failed records”; reconcile unknown outcomes before retrying. Announce summarized progress.
actions.check: Disconnect after several committed writes, reload, and retry. Verify successful changes are not reapplied and requests contain only confirmed IDs.
actions.risk: Deduplication must be durable and atomic with each write.

actions.action: Explain and enforce reversal eligibility per record
actions.mechanism: A ten-minute deadline and post-write version guard prevent reversal from overwriting subsequent changes.
actions.implementation: Store prior statuses, resulting versions, and policy deadlines. Reverse eligible IDs conditionally; provide keyboard-accessible record lookup with deadline or subsequent-change explanations.
actions.check: Test expiry and a subsequent edit, including changing back to the same status. Verify reversal fails safely and screen readers expose the reason.
actions.risk: Eligibility can change after display; recheck atomically during reversal.
